versions.subject: Add 2 defense-evasion T1562.001 rules
versions.detection:
selection_action:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Stop-Service '
        - 'Remove-Service '
selection_product:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' McAfeeDLPAgentService'
        - ' Trend Micro Deep Security Manager'
        - ' TMBMServer'
        # Feel free to add more service name         
condition: all of them
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*Stop-Service *", "*Remove-Service *") CommandLine IN ("* McAfeeDLPAgentService*", "* Trend Micro Deep Security Manager*", "* TMBMServer*")

c.t: P:CommandLine|IN|('L', (('S', '* McAfeeDLPAgentService*'), ('S', '* TMBMServer*'), ('S', '* Trend Micro Deep Security Manager*')))|CTX:POS
